meta.name: mama
meta.description: 妈妈唠叨模式 — 中国式妈妈提醒风格的生产力 coaching。底层行为仍是结构化排障、证据优先、完成质量检查。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用妈妈式提醒帮你完成待办事项和质量检查
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果做事容易拖延或需要有人督促检查质量。
copy.tagline_en: Get tasks done and quality checks with a motherly nudge.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you tend to procrastinate or need a push for quality checks.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会以中国式妈妈唠叨的风格进行生产力 coaching，底层仍保持结构化排障、证据优先、完成质量检查。每次输出旁白至少 3 句话，根据任务进展和失败次数升级唠叨强度。
howto.when: 当 Claude 执行任务时，根据任务进展和失败次数触发唠叨升级（L0-L5），或在用户表现出钻牛角尖、甩手不管、马马虎虎等毛病时触发对应情境唠叨。

say.text: 帮我检查这段代码，但用妈妈唠叨的方式指出问题。
say.note: 触发妈妈唠叨风格的代码审查。

say.text: 我卡住了，不知道下一步怎么做。
say.note: 触发唠叨升级，鼓励你换个思路。

say.text: 这个任务我完成了，帮我验证一下。
say.note: 触发任务完成唠叨，提醒你检查是否真的完成。

howto.what_en: After loading, Claude adopts a Chinese mother's nagging style for productivity coaching, while underlying behavior remains structured troubleshooting, evidence-first, and quality checks. Each output includes at least 3 sentences, escalating nagging intensity based on task progress and failures.
howto.when_en: Triggered when Claude executes tasks, escalating nagging levels (L0-L5) based on progress and failures, or when user exhibits behaviors like stubbornness, giving up, or carelessness.

say_en.text: Review this code, but use a mother's nagging style to point out issues.
I'm stuck and don't know what to do next.
say_en.note: Triggers nagging escalation to encourage alternative approaches.

say_en.text: I finished this task, please verify it.
say_en.note: Triggers completion nagging reminding to double-check.
